notes.title: Content update DOOMER №1 is available! Changelog post.
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44355443/2152978a1c153df1a05982cbf23fa164c59ddb1d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=n5YBh0wvxQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings from the Doomer development team! 

We apologize for the long absence of any news and game updates since the announcement of our roadmap. As is often the case, everything that could go wrong went wrong. As we built all the processes and implemented what we promised, it took more time than expected.

Now that the time has come, we are pleased to present you with the first content update, which is quite significant in scope, but represents only a small part of what's planned.

Let's talk about future plans before we get into the details of the update. From now on, we'll release updates more frequently. We can't reveal the content or dates yet, but there won't be such long breaks between updates anymore. In the next step, we'll rework the technical foundation of the game, optimize everything that's "under the hood", and then start developing game mechanics.  

And yes, you read that right, Doomer will feature game mechanics and a clearly defined gameplay cycle. And naturally, we will add more nostalgic items, references, and elements that are signature to the time. 

Sincerely yours, the Doomer team.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

Now for the content update:

[h3]1) Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doomer can now run, jump, and crouch; 
[*] When running, the camera wobbles more intensely than when walking; 
[*] Removed camera shake with the option to turn it on if you want to; 
[*] The phone model has been updated to Pokia :), which is more relevant to the time when the game takes place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a188f61e42894362f6dbb6bd19c2a4fc4ea0527a.png[/img]

[*] The phone interface has been updated with the ability to call, but no one will answer...yet.
[*] The ability to take photos through the phone has been removed, since it does not correspond to the time of the game. We will get back to this and explore ideas of how to do photos and screenshots later. However, it won't be done with the phone camera, that is for sure.
[*] A redesigned item interaction system has been added. For example, the rat isn't a part of your pocket anymore. It lives in the cage. You can get it out and put it back in.
[*] Like any doomer character can now die, there are several ways to do that. Feel free to experiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/3e68d2ac9c7474b79bd45d5cb99dbf2d07a1ff5e.png[/img]

[h3]2) Doomers apartment: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You are able to open and close almost all of the doors and windows in the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/5cff5bcf28629d3bccc022a901099b6a09f0aeee.png[/img]

[*] Now, there are switches in all rooms, so lights can be turned on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/b3d54fe0f6aa26a5e0e0a21749cc4e7d1b02a681.png[/img]

[*] A gas stove can be lit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/98dfcd234bd4ae7c34de82ee0425524b897f0adf.png[/img]

[*] Lots and lots of authentic items that are appropriate for the time the events of the game take place. Brand new models of items made from scratch, including Dendy consoles, cartridges, videotapes, books, Great Dragon and Technics of Youth magazines, as well as video and audio tape recorders. There is no sense to list it all, just explore and enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/da0d2dc40de74973c52b9f4b9aafbb0ba00a3db3.png[/img]

[*] It is now possible to pick up and inspect items. At the moment, not all of the items are eligible for that, but we will be gradually adding the ability to inspect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d0462bd2891aadd4e39545f58ff27014393bbe9f.png[/img]

[*] You can now watch TV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/4733d70221e4a1471087a9f3680376decc5c4f2c.png[/img]

[*] The apartment has a telephone now, you should expect a call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/0d68cd37f25ba3bc4c6c04775a1246941081907a.png[/img]

[*] There has been a change in the apartment's furnishings. Now that Doomer has a new table, he has rearranged some stuff around the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a0829a33c001b6476d352c65d53fc1b5737e4da3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]3) Other: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The apartment building has the entrance now, you can access it from the doomers apartment. It allows you to go out onto the street, or access the roof. We attempted to make the entrance as authentic as possible using relevant objects and attributes of the time, writings on the walls, ashtrays, bottles, etc. You can explore, ring your neighbors doorbells and find ways to entertain yourself, maybe getting an achievement or two while you are at it. We'll add more activities over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/21af654deca04ab7b71da3c2f58b8e0c5866fc48.png[/img]

[*] You can access the roof now. There you can walk around, smoke a cigarette and contemplate about your life while looking at the surrounding landscape from above. That, and all other sorts of activities you can think of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/ed588cf12a3e2d49c65d176816eb067478b96803.png[/img]

[*] The lighting has been updated, smoothly transitioning to dynamic lighting;
[*] A variety of ambient sounds, clocks, birds outside the window, street noise, computer startup, and others have been added;
[*] Picked bottles can be thrown anywhere if you click the left mouse button after picking them up. Give it a try, experiment with it...
[*] The railroad in the area is now fully operational. Watch the departing train doomer and think about life...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/22e9c53431eab3db83538a30e8ebaa4288659f6a.png[/img]

[*] There are many hidden activities now. We won't reveal them, but we are sure you'll enjoy finding them. Don't be afraid to explore the neighborhood and the apartment, something interesting is surely waiting for you there.
[*] Lines 97 is now installed on the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/148831f1c301faefebc99afe8b59060462602009.png[/img]

[*] Several parked cars appeared on the streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/f6c1c58ff973e05e6ba858dcb99dbe29dbb768d2.png[/img]

[*] The apartment buildings themselves were embellished with authentic external elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/39c98f3492ff6d169f16dc25766b04390af4f81d.png[/img]

[*] Old achievements have been remade to match the spirit of the game and the changes we've made. You'll find new secret achievements as well, look for ways to unlock them and just have fun.  
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy the game!!![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

notes.title: Update release date
notes.notes:
All are welcome! The exact release date of the update has become known, it is scheduled for 11/13/2021 10:00 PST.

Secretly, a quest will be added in the update for a few days, which will be written about later. Stay tuned for updates and we wish you a good game!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394164/b297cc7a53fc6ec0ab7f9fc4c6801a7f0933733a.png[/img]
Hello survivor! A major game update is coming soon. The game engine was changed to Unreal Engine. The update will affect all aspects of the game, because of this, the save will be lost. Improved performance, graphics quality, added new interactions, vehicles, improved sound quality, and more.

Are you ready for the big update?

notes.title: 0.2.1.5 - Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394164/3ac31176ac4607d1f7709d2d9ff66ec33e0a534e.png[/img]

Hello to all survivors!

The update practically does not affect the mechanics of the game, it will be a little later. But in the update, the game has been redesigned based on feedback from players for a more comfortable game.

In the update:
-Reduced the difficulty of the game
-Added a new location "Abandoned Garden"
-Added a map by pressing the "M" button
-Added an option to the pause menu "Save backpack after death?"
-Added 2 tabs with initial tasks
-Removed the spawn of evil mobs and animals within a radius of 100 meters in the place where the game starts and the character spawns after death
-Fixed a bug of small stairs disappearing near houses
-To kill a chicken, 1 hit is enough
-Light bulb and torch light changed to be more pleasant
-Fixed a bug when arrows did not reload
-Fixed a bug when the player slept under the bed
-Deleting a base after "destroying its zombies" was removed as most players were confused after that
-The logic of deer was reworked, they used to chase and attack the player, now they bypass the player
-The night light has been slightly redesigned and the night has been slightly lighter
-Reduced the cycle time of day and night
-The appearance of mobs has become less frequent

Plans for the next updates:
-Weather
-Transport
-Undersea world
-More animals

*Special thanks to VenomousJack and Stalker for the images provided.

notes.title: Update 0.1.9.5
notes.notes:
Hello to all survivors! The Gone development team is in touch.

An update has been released that has brought the game much closer to leaving Early Access.

In the update:
-Added bushes (by collecting a bush you can get a rope and from 5 ropes you can make a cloth or a rope)
-Added several not large locations and one huge one called "Station"
-Added difficulty of the game (configurable in the game menu)
-Added the effect of falling leaves from trees
-Fixes minor bugs with sound
-Fixed not saving sensitivity settings
-Fixed display of changed keys
-Fixed not saving corn after reboot
-Reworked damage from hits (shots) weapons

notes.title: 0.1.7.10 - Long-awaited update
notes.notes:
Hello to all survivors!

An update has come out that everyone has been waiting for. More than half of the application was rewritten, so this update was delayed for such a long time. This will allow us to quickly release updates in the future, as well as delight you with new mechanics.

In the update:
-added languages: Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Russian and Italian
-added the ability to change the keyboard layout
-added birds
-added well
-added new locations
-added player statistics (after death)
-fixed the slider for changing the sensitivity
-added an icon in the notification (of what you picked up or mined)
-fixed inability to drop large objects (bed, chest, stove, etc.)
-fixed incorrect display of text in some interfaces
-fixed not being able to chop a tree into logs in winter terrain
-changed brightness of lamps and torches
-improved fire wave from flamethrower
-fixed not hits from some weapons
-zombies and animals no longer walk through objects and can enter the house
-reworked the economy of the game
-fixed problems with saving lamps, time, resources in stoves, bonfires and more
-now there is no need to reload the bow as a weapon, this happens automatically when there are arrows in the backpack
-added a warning window, at the request of players, when starting a new game
-fixed the game freezing at the first throw of a spear or shooting
-added saving of felled trees and mined stones (trees will grow over time)

Plans for the next updates:
-Transport
-Weather
-More objects for the construction of their structures
-Productivity increase
-Undersea world
-More animals
-And much more

notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37394164/e6c78e1a2cef5ed35ccaf633770fd47394f5562c.png[/img]
Hello to all survivors! We apologize immediately for the delayed update! Many bugs and glitches were fixed. Several mechanics have also been reworked. If you have any questions or concerns, you can describe them in the "Sections for Bugs" discussion. A keyboard layout change will be added soon.

Full list of changes:
-Fixed issue with saving on most devices due to path
-Redesigned mechanics of tree felling and stone mining
-Added achievements
-Slightly redesigned crafting interface
-Added the ability to rotate objects during construction
-Redesigned game sounds
-Fixed bug when ESC, did not close inventory, but opened pause menu
-Added the ability to parse almost every item. To do this, you must be in the anvil interface. When parsing, there is a chance that it will turn out to get some of the items from which the item was created.
-The construction of a building requires a different amount of resources
-Fixed torch (sound, sparks, glow, etc.)
-Items found in zombies now have an random. Depending on what the zombie found while walking on the map
-Fixed bug when trees grew in the house
-Added a circle of status when mining something
-Added random spawn animals and zombies
-In the chests, loot is replenished over time
-Fixed a bug when there was no room in the inventory and when crafting or lifting things, they disappeared
-Added the ability to clamp the button to increase and decrease the number of items for crafting
-Fix a bug when Airdrop appeared outside the coverage area (behind high walls full of radiation)
-After collecting AirDrop, it disappears
-Added effect when hit in a zombie or animal
-Added a notification when a player tried to break something with the wrong tool
-Was work was done on item descriptions
-Fixed bug with infinite and sterals
-Added tips on what to put in stoves and other tools
-Fixed bug of impossibility to break the tent, campfire, bed, etc.
-Fixed animations, damage, the number of lives of animals and zombies
-Fixed slightly flying asphalt in some places
-Coster at work now deals damage if you come very close to it
-Increased volume of chests
-Fixed bug with flying stones
-Bugs with radiation have been fixed
-Fixed flickering of some objects

A bit of FAQ:
• When you exit the game, energy saving lamp goes out
• To make the house light, it is necessary to put a torch in it (this can be done in the Bulding Hammer menu)
• Learn what can be made of what
• Make an ax better or a pick and you will mine more
• Weapons can be reload by transferring cartridges to it
• In order to take half the stack, hold down the SHIFT key and move the desired item to another cell in the inventory
• To quickly transfer items from any storage to inventory, you need to hold down the SHIFT key and click on this item or stack of items

notes.title: The long-awaited release!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

Тomorrow will already have the opportunity to download and try to survive in the game Gone:Survival!

Please note that the game is currently under development and may have bugs. We really need your support and we are waiting for an offer on our mailbox codenstudio@outlook.com or on the forum steam.

Regards, Coden Studio Team.
